name: @jixo/opendweb-ext-cf
description: opendweb plugin — Cloudflare Tunnel exposure wizard (ingress push via API, end-to-end verification, optional cloudflared co-spawn)

scripts.pack:dry: npm run build && npm pack --dry-run && node -e "const p=require('./package.json'),fs=require('fs');const deps=p.dependencies??{};if(Object.keys(deps).length>0){console.error('unexpected runtime dependencies:',deps);process.exit(1)}const BUNDLED=['@clack','cloudflare','cloudflared'];let kb=0;for(const f of fs.readdirSync('dist')){const st=fs.statSync('dist/'+f);kb+=st.size;if(!f.endsWith('.mjs'))continue;const text=fs.readFileSync('dist/'+f,'utf8');for(const line of text.split('\\n')){const t=line.trim();if((t.startsWith('import')||t.startsWith('export'))&&BUNDLED.some(b=>t.includes('\"'+b))){console.error('bundled dependency leaked in dist/'+f+':',t);process.exit(1)}}}console.log('runtime dependencies: none; no bundled imports leaked; dist size:',Math.round(kb/1024),'KB');if(kb>2048*1024){console.error('dist too large');process.exit(1)}"
